conunit.name: ConUnit rule catalog (pkg/conunit/rules.go) of the evaluated build
conunit.note: ConUnit is the tool under test, so there is no pinned version: the build that ran is recorded in raw/tools.json. The rules SPEC-09, SPEC-10 and FS-10 of the lint pack are defined by docs/INTERFACE_V2.md section 3 and implemented by another work package, so their entries could not be checked against a catalog in this tree and are marked unverified.

cst.name: container-structure-test documented test types (README)
cst.note: container-structure-test has no rule catalog. It ships four test types (command, file existence, file content, metadata) and the policy is written by the user. A property is in scope when one of these documented types can express it against the built image, and the policy file in fixtures/rq1/cst is authored by the benchmark author.

dockle.name: Dockle checkpoints (CHECKPOINT.md) and assessors
dockle.note: CHECKPOINT.md and the assessors under pkg/assessor are read at tag v0.4.15. Run from a docker-archive with --input, Dockle does not evaluate DKL-DI-0006 (the latest tag check needs an image name), CIS-DI-0005 reads DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST of the scanning host and CIS-DI-0002 has no code path. A checkpoint missing from the report can also hide a failed assessor, because an assessor error is only logged.

hadolint.name: Hadolint rules (README rules table and rule pages)
hadolint.note: The README table is read at tag v2.14.0. The rule pages in the wiki are not versioned with releases and were read on the retrieval date.

trivy.name: Trivy Dockerfile checks (trivy-checks) and builtin secret rules
trivy.note: Trivy 0.76.1 (commit e713f67f7d54decdcd9b3132c9751833dcced698) embeds the trivy-checks module version v1.12.2-0.20261012053351-ac85645895ed, read from its go.mod. The run uses --skip-check-update, so the embedded checks apply. Secret rule IDs are read from pkg/fanal/secret/builtin-rules.go at tag v0.76.1.
